data.body: The ADEVX-149 plan review that degraded to INDETERMINATE recorded DDGSException No results found from the review agent web search in session log 04da-1bc1-09d6-4b75. It ran alongside the ADEVX-150 review, and the same review passed when rerun alone, but no evidence ties the failure to the concurrency. The recorded cause is the web search exception.
